_comment: PCAP validation cases. primary_sid is the rule the PCAP was built for; expect_sids is the full list of SIDs that must alert. Alerts outside the list are only reported as unexpected (not a failure). PCAPs are built by generate_samples.py.

cases.description: External scanner requests the web server with the default Nmap NSE User-Agent
